name: The Residences at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley
positioning: Modern mountain condos with kitchens and Jordanelle Reservoir views, steps from Deer Valley Resort skiing, with access to the amenities of Grand Hyatt Deer Valley
best_for: Skiers who want a residence steps from Deer Valley Resort
Families who want one- to three-bedroom space with a full kitchen

facts.text: The residences are modern mountain condos with views of Jordanelle Reservoir.
Residences come in one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts.
The residences feature mountain modern design and spa-inspired bathrooms.
Residence guests have access to the amenities of Grand Hyatt Deer Valley.
Sunspell Pool + Provisions has panoramic views of Jordanelle Reservoir and the Wasatch Mountains.
Agaci Spa + Wellness at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley offers massages and facials.
The residences have a dedicated on-site concierge team that helps with transportation, dinner reservations and excursions.
Camp Hyatt offers kids aged 3 to 8 a playhouse, arts and crafts and books, by request.
The Nexus Lounge & Arcade has PS5 and Xbox systems, air hockey, ping pong and vintage arcade games.
Remington Hall is the signature restaurant, serving breakfast, brunch and dinner.
Dogs are welcome, and there is a dedicated dog run on-property.

highlights.text: The residences are steps from Deer Valley Resort skiing.
A ski butler service offers personalized fittings, on-mountain support and returns.
Ski gear rentals are available on-property.

considerations.text: The spa, restaurants and other amenities are those of Grand Hyatt Deer Valley rather than the residences themselves.
Private terraces come with most residences, not all of them.
WhataHotel notes availability is primarily during ski season.
